name: The Spirits of Stonetalon
summary: Unrest stirs among the spirits of Stonetalon, and Zor Lonetree sends Horde champions west to learn why. From Orgrimmar, they travel past the Crossroads and report directly to Seereth Stonebreak near Greatwood Vale.

sections.title: A Cry from the West
sections.body: In Grommash Hold, Zor Lonetree listens to the natural world and feels deep distress from the Stonetalon Mountains. The elemental spirits of its rocky peaks are furious as logging tears into their forests. Horde shamans hear that unrest and fear the devastation in the western highlands will upset Kalimdor's spiritual balance.

sections.title: Industrial Deforestation
sections.body: The Venture Company, an unscrupulous goblin syndicate, is cutting timber in Greatwood Vale. Its commercial crews use aggressive machinery, saws, and muscle to butcher the ancient woodland instead of harvesting sustainably. The Horde sent Seereth Stonebreak, a young shaman, to watch the forest from the frontier and rally defenders against the ravagers.

faq.q: Who starts this quest and where are they located?
faq.answer: Zor Lonetree, an orc advisor, offers this in Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Where can I find Seereth Stonebreak?
faq.answer: Seereth Stonebreak waits in the Stonetalon Mountains, along the path near Greatwood Vale, just past the eastern entrance from the northern Barrens.

faq.q: Why are the spirits of Stonetalon angry?
faq.answer: The Venture Company goblins are clear-cutting the mountain woods, provoking the land's elemental guardians.

faq.q: How do I reach the Stonetalon Mountains from Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Travel south from Orgrimmar across the Barrens to the Crossroads, then follow the westward road through the rocky pass into Stonetalon.

faq.q: What comes next after speaking with Seereth?
faq.answer: At her camp, Seereth Stonebreak gives you Goblin Invaders, sending you into Greatwood Vale to eliminate loggers and cut down their operations.

faq.q: Why is the Horde intervening in Stonetalon's deforestation?
faq.answer: Tauren and orc shamans revere the elemental spirits. Reckless goblin logging harms the land's spiritual harmony and threatens the borders of the Barrens.

angles.text: As a shaman, you hear a plea from the elements to mend the bond between earth and the living.
As a tauren, you carry a cultural duty to soothe the earth and defend sacred forests from goblin logging.
As a member of the Horde, you help keep travel routes between Stonetalon and the Barrens clear of rogue commercial syndicates.
